lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: Approximately five horizontal rows of high-luminance circular spots extending from the posterior gill slits toward the caudal region, with the highest density of clusters concentrated in the mid-lateral area dorsal to the pectoral fin.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Faint vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersect the primary horizontal spot rows, creating a grid-like configuration of anchor nodes most visible in the region between the fifth gill slit and the vertical axis of the first dorsal fin.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three distinct longitudinal ridges are visible on the upper flank; the most prominent medial ridge displays a sharp vertical gradient with high pixel intensity on the dorsal edge and deep shadow on the ventral edge, running parallel to the dorsal midline.

other_distinctive_markers: Multiple Echeneidae (remora) individuals are attached to the ventral-lateral region and trailing the pectoral fin; high-intensity light rays (caustics) penetrate the water column, causing localized overexposure on the anterior-dorsal surface.
